title: PROBE: Frontier Coding Agents Find Different Bugs Than Maintainers Fix
abstract: arXiv:2610.35987v1 Announce Type: cross  Abstract: Proactive bug discovery is an important software-engineering problem. Even though coding agents are already widely deployed in this domain, their capabilities remain understudied. In particular, the challenging task of finding all bugs that human maintainers would repair across an entire repository has not been studied yet. To close this gap, we introduce PROBE, a benchmark consisting of all 2,457 bugs fixed over the course of 18 months across 20 diverse GitHub repositories, together with a method for matching candidate findings to this partial reference set. We evaluate coding agents across frontier models and find they all achieve a recall of below $21\%$ and a precision of less than $9\%$ with respect to the reference set. While stronger models increase recall substantially from $8\%$ to $17\%$, they do not improve precision. Surprisingly, despite the low precision, LLM and human evaluators still judge $85\%$ of findings valid. Cruc

translated_title: PROBE：前沿编码智能体发现的Bug与维护者修复的Bug不同
translated_abstract: 主动式漏洞发现是软件工程中的一个重要问题。尽管编码智能体已在该领域被广泛部署，但其能力仍未得到充分研究。特别是，在整个代码仓库中找出人类维护者会修复的所有漏洞这一具有挑战性的任务尚未被研究过。为了填补这一空白，我们提出了PROBE，一个包含20个多样化GitHub代码仓库在18个月内修复的全部2,457个漏洞的基准测试，并配套了一种将候选发现与该部分参考集进行匹配的方法。我们评估了基于多个前沿模型的编码智能体，发现它们相对于参考集的召回率均低于21%，精确率低于9%。虽然更强的模型将召回率从8%大幅提升至17%，但并不能提高精确率。令人惊讶的是，尽管精确率很低，LLM和人类评估者仍然判定85%的发现是有效的。
tldr: 本文提出PROBE基准测试，揭示前沿编码智能体在仓库漏洞发现中召回率和精确率均很低，且其找到的漏洞与人类维护者实际修复的漏洞存在系统性差异。
en_tdlr: The PROBE benchmark reveals that frontier coding agents achieve low recall and precision in bug discovery across repositories, and systematically find different bugs than those human maintainers actually fix.
